outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured photoactivation images of single cells without quantification, so replicate reporting does not apply.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A) (red: euchromatin, green: heterochromatin).
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B shows quantified intensity decay curves with model fits and inset averages with error bars, implying averaging over multiple measurements/experiments, but the caption gives no n-number or description of what constitutes a replicate (e.g., number of cells, spots, or independent experiments averaged).
